title: Painting to RCC Lighthouse Tower and GI Trestle tower at Paradip Lighthouse & DGPS Station - reg.
summary: Two-cover e-tender for painting the RCC lighthouse tower and the GI trestle tower at Paradip Lighthouse and DGPS Station, Odisha.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Paradip Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Paradip, Odisha
sites.work: Painting of RCC lighthouse tower and GI trestle tower

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata payable at Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption of EMD not allowed; original EMD to reach office by 07/09/2024 15:00. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (Building civil work) in Central govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State govt

Similar works in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; similar works = repairs & maintenance or construction of any type of building works (RCC or masonry); values enhanced at 7% p.a.
Notarized affidavit (2024) of not blacklisted/debarred; unconditional price bid undertaking; tender acceptance letter
notes: NIT only; no BOQ or paint specifications. Dated 19/08/2024. Bid download 19/08/2024 15:00 to 07/09/2024 15:00; pre-bid 27/08/2024 15:00; technical opening 09/09/2024 16:00. Bidders asked to visit site before quoting.
